headline: NVR (NVR) Earnings And Buybacks Put Its Fair Value Debate Back In Focus
summary: NVR (NVR) has drawn investor attention after reporting second quarter 2026 earnings along with updates on its ongoing share repurchase programs, offering fresh data on profitability and capital returns. See our latest analysis for NVR. NVR's latest earnings and active buyback activity sit against a share price of $6,147.05 that has moved lower in recent months, with the stock down 7.48% on a 1 month share price return basis and 15.55% on a year to date share price return basis.
